summary.headline: Arotech captures $100K in new annual savings across four indirect spend categories
summary.narrative: During 2022 Treya Partners completed four strategic sourcing work-streams for Arotech—car rental, hotels, IT hardware bought through Amazon, and MRO supplies—delivering a validated $100,069 in additional annual savings. These new wins lift the engagement’s post-baseline total to roughly $600K, with final signatures now the only remaining step for full realization. Contract documents have been drafted and routed; once executed, the savings will begin flowing immediately through updated rates and new supplier agreements.

total_annual_savings.notes: Sum of Savings-in-Hand figures on Slide 4 (Car Rental, Hotels, Amazon IT Hardware, MRO).

finalized_savings.notes: All four categories are awaiting final signature or roll-out; none are yet marked 'implemented'.

in_progress_savings.notes: All savings currently in progress / awaiting signature.

category_results.status_notes: Enterprise/National OMNIA agreement drafted; documents sent via DocuSign on 12/8, awaiting client completion (Slide 3).
IHG chain-wide discount loaded in Egencia; one remaining property-specific agreement sent to client for signature (Slide 5).
Connection pricing negotiated; client to begin funneling Amazon IT hardware spend through Connection contract (Slide 5).
Dual-source solution finalized (keep Grainger, add Fastenal via OMNIA); participation agreement sent to client on 12/13 (Slide 3 & 5).

value_realized_in_days.notes: First-savings start date depends on execution of pending contracts; not yet specified.

time_to_value.notes: All work-streams are contract-ready; savings will commence once documents are signed and supplier rates loaded.

impact.operational_improvements: Standardized national supplier agreements were negotiated, enabling centralized travel booking through Egencia, automated OMNIA GPO pricing for MRO, and a consolidated IT hardware channel to curb Amazon marketplace leakage.

proof_points.statement: Switching to the OMNIA/Enterprise car rental program lowers daily rates by 13-32%, driving $29.6K in annual savings on Arotech’s $185K spend.
Property-specific hotel negotiations plus an IHG chain-wide Business Edge enrollment capture 6% savings, worth $37.5K annually.

evidence.quote: Treya has negotiated ... 6% or $37,500 in hotel savings on its annual hotel spend baseline of ~$615K

proof_points.statement: Redirecting half of Amazon IT hardware purchases to Connection at negotiated pricing cuts costs by 5%, saving $15.5K a year.
Dual-source MRO strategy with Fastenal via OMNIA supplements Grainger and delivers 6% savings, valued at $17.5K per year.

evidence.quote: Final MRO savings are $17K ... 6% or $17K in MRO savings is available to Arotech

extraction_sources: New Sourceable Categories vMS/Project Updates/Arotech Strategic Sourcing Project Update (121322).pptx
extraction_notes: Slide 4 'Savings Tracker – New 2022 Workstreams' lists $100,069 in 'Savings in Hand'; this aligns with the Executive Summary’s '$100K in incremental savings'.

Slide 12 shows different interim estimates (total $114,648). Higher-priority within the same document is assumed to be Slide 4 since it is explicitly labeled 'Savings in Hand'. Values from Slide 4 were used.
No Priority 1 (Close-Out) or Priority 2 (Case Study) documents were provided; Priority 3 numbers therefore serve as the authoritative results.
